measurement_notes: Opening measures an owned, already-decoded source through first event processing, including editor creation and annotation restoration.
Pan/zoom includes event delivery and painting. Crop/undo/redo measures pixel preparation and history transition together.
Export renders an immutable full-resolution image snapshot on the export worker.
Peak resident bytes is the cumulative process high-water mark. Retained private bytes is the change after three sessions close, relative to the preloaded-source baseline.
Wall-clock measurements on a shared desktop are report-only and are not latency thresholds. Repeat on an idle host before comparing performance regressions.
The host was at 100% total CPU utilization immediately after the final run, with another linker still active. Treat these timings as contended-host observations.
